title: Rice Registry Item
description: A single distributable item in a rice registry. Schema is a Nix-extended adaptation of shadcn/ui's registry-item.json (https://ui.shadcn.com/schema/registry-item.json).

name.description: Lowercase, kebab-case identifier unique within the registry.

type.description: The kind of artifact. Drives slot semantics and renderer expectations.

registryDependencies.description: Other registry items this depends on. By name (same registry), namespaced (@ns/name), or absolute URL to a registry-item.json.

nixpkgsDependencies.description: nixpkgs derivation names this item needs at runtime (e.g. 'matugen', 'grim').

files.description: Source files copied or imported into the user's config.

path.description: Source-relative path. Resolved against the directory of rice.json at build time.

target.description: Destination path placeholder (e.g. '@home/.config/quickshell/{name}/Bar.qml'). Optional for module:* types which are imported.

content.description: Inlined file content. Populated by `nix-rice build` from `path`.

cssVars.description: Token values, scoped. Components reference token names; themes set values; swap = swap values, no component changes.

compatibility.description: Version constraints for the runtime substrate. Resolver checks before install.

slots.description: Explicit slot declarations. Drives conflict surfacing in the resolver.

previews.description: Visual previews. Paths are source-relative; URLs are absolute.

targets.description: Substrate tags this item targets. Resolver requires every tag to be satisfied by the user's machine profile, except 'any' which is universal. Vocabulary: compositors (hyprland, sway, niri, river, kwin, mutter, gnome-shell), bars (waybar, quickshell, eww, ags, gbar, polybar), toolkits (gtk3, gtk4, qt5, qt6), DEs (gnome, kde, xfce, cinnamon, cosmic, lxqt, mate, budgie), session (wayland, x11), or 'any'.

meta.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata. Reserved for renderer-specific extensions.
